description: This file defines the OA_Dal_Statistics class, which provides methods for generating SQL WHERE clauses, retrieving daily and hourly statistics, and handling date/time conversions related to statistics in the Revive Adserver project.

classes.name: OA_Dal_Statistics
classes.description: Class providing statistical data retrieval and date handling methods for the Revive Adserver.

methods.name: getWhereDate
methods.description: Constructs SQL WHERE clause for date range filtering based on start and end dates.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the current timezone object based on the useUTC parameter.

methods.name: setTimeAndReturnUTC
methods.description: Creates a copy of a Date object with specified time and converts it to UTC.

methods.name: getDailyStatsAsArray
methods.description: Executes a query and returns grouped daily statistics, adjusting for timezone if needed.

methods.name: getHourlyStatsAsArray
methods.description: Executes a query and returns grouped hourly statistics, adjusting for timezone if needed.

methods.name: quoteTableName
methods.description: Quotes and returns the full table name with prefix.
